brief: I'm not happy with the current drowned village chapter still. It has some kind of weird, invisible, regular patterning all across the image, and the knit sail looks a bit too realistic and out of place. can you take a look and see if you can come up with anything better using imagegen?
status: Study 03 was initially accepted on 2026-10-05, then superseded by approved study 07 after the diagonal swatch repair. Study 07 is installed as the landscape painting and chapter tile with a matching portrait. Latest approval: ../sea-mirror-study-2026-10-05/generation.json.
recommendation: 03-quiet-painting.png. Broad matte sail folds, quieter cloud masses and water. Keeps original rear view and landmarks.
findings: The previous generation prompt explicitly called for knitted courses and ribs. The retained studies remove the literal knit rendering. Repetitive cloud and water detail was simplified; no claim is made about an in-game shader defect.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: replacement chapter painting study for Updraft, landscape 16:9.
Input image 1 is the current drowned-village painting: use it for scene identity, camera and object placement, but REPAINT the whole image freshly. Do not preserve its surface texture.
Keep the low view from behind the little rounded clinker wooden boat, boat a little left of centre, warm lantern, tall red scarf used as a sail, scattered half-submerged cottage gables and chimney pots, bare branching trees, church spire centre-right, white lighthouse far right. No people, animals or new props. Keep the full sail inside the image.
Art direction: a beautifully resolved painted animated-film background, soft luminous dusk, simple sculptural shapes, warm apricot light from the left balanced by smoky lilac distance and plum-blue water. Quiet, nostalgic, a little strange, homes the water took. Retain dimensional light and clear focal shapes without photographic detail. Smooth digital paint, with broad organically shaped cloud masses and selective soft edges.
Critical change 1: the red sail should feel like an illustrated soft wool scarf. Model it with just a few broad, gentle folds, matte brick-red and vermilion colour, slightly irregular soft hem, and only a whisper of textile shading. NO visible knit stitches, cable-knit ridges, braided rows, yarn filaments or embossed ribbing. It must belong to the same painted world as the roofs and boat.
Critical change 2: remove the regular patterning completely. The sky consists of a few broad asymmetric cloud masses separated by calm luminous air. Water has spacious, long soft reflections of actual objects, a few irregular curved ripples, quiet broad coloured planes. NOT evenly spaced glints or thousands of small ripple marks. No canvas/paper texture, grain, screen-door pattern, crosshatching, tiled texture, repeating brush stamps, grid, stipple or noise anywhere.
Composition: keep the scene's current object hierarchy and low perspective. The lower centre is naturally darker quieter water for a separately added Continue button, not a blank band. Full bleed, no text, no UI, no borders. Produce a finished, clean high-quality landscape painting.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished landscape chapter painting for Updraft, a dreamy meditative game, 16:9 wide.
Paint the drowned village at dusk as a luminous hand-painted animated-film environment. The mood is the strange tender quiet of finding a familiar village asleep under water. A little rounded wooden clinker sailboat is sailing away from us among submerged cottage rooftops. Viewpoint LOW behind the boat, only a little above the water, not an aerial view.
The boat stands a little left of centre, with a stout dark mast and a tall single red scarf-sail. Sail silhouette is an upright tapering four-sided shape, narrow at its top and widening toward a low wooden boom. Paint the scarf as soft matte brick-red fabric with two or three broad folds, a little coral light along its wind-filled edge, subtle wool softness, no individual stitches or ribbed pattern. A warm tiny lantern on a thick cream bow post. Simple beautifully painted wooden hull with a few wide strakes. No passengers, birds or animals.
Cottage gables, steep roofs and chimney pots stand directly out of the water at varied irregular distances, all houses submerged to their eaves. A few bare tree crowns reach out of the water. A modest church tower with pointed spire toward centre-right. A tall white lighthouse with a faint warm beam at the distant right. No shore, no mountains, no extra objects.
Light: a lingering apricot sunset glow from the left fading into muted rose and dusky lavender across the sky; cooler blue-violet water and softly silhouetted roofs. The lantern and red scarf are the intimate warm notes. A few great soft asymmetrical cloud shapes with luminous edges, quiet open air between them. Emotional depth through colour and overlapping silhouettes, not detail.
Water: calm, broad areas of blended colour. Long softly broken reflections associated with each roof and sail, a few expressive irregular horizontal strokes. Spacious darker foreground water with gentle broad ripples, suitable for a separate Continue label below centre. No artificial blank UI band.
Medium: clean digital painting, beautifully modelled simple forms, selective sharp edges on boat and nearest roofs, soft atmospheric distance. Brushwork follows form and varies in scale. This is NOT a photograph or a raytraced 3D render. Avoid tiny granular details, photographic clouds, realistic yarn, canvas texture, paper grain, all-over noise, repeating marks, crosshatching, grid or tile artifacts. No text, frame or watermark. Full finished painting, not a loose sketch.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: Updraft drowned village chapter painting, landscape 16:9.
Input image: EDIT TARGET. Preserve the entire composition, positions and scale of the boat, sail, rooftops, trees, church, lighthouse, and low rear view. The boat MUST still be sailing AWAY from the viewer, its rounded stern and little white rudder nearest us. Preserve all objects and their number.
Make ONE coherent change: simplify the surface rendering across this painting into a quieter, more hand-painted animated-film world. Keep beautiful dimensional lighting and luminous sunset colour, but replace photographic microdetail with softly blended painted colour and selective broad edges. Slightly calmer apricot rather than intensely orange in the sky, cool lavender-blue in shaded water. This should remain a polished dimensional painting, not flat vector art.
On the red scarf-sail, preserve its silhouette but replace every tiny texture mark with smooth matte brick-red colour shaped by three broad soft folds; a subtle soft fuzzy edge can suggest wool. No visible knit stitches, ribs, yarn loops, embossed pattern or mottling.
On the water, radically simplify the ripples into long spacious softly blended reflections, with only a handful of fine irregular surface accents near objects. Broader simpler less regular wave shapes. Large areas of calm water should rest between the reflections. The boat and its red reflected sail remain clear. No all-over sparkle.
Clouds should be a few connected spacious soft masses, not little stamped puffs; soft clean transitions through their interiors. Preserve the light direction, glowing left horizon, and atmospheric recession.
Absolutely no canvas grain, paper texture, dither, crosshatching, grid, checker, screen pattern, repeating brush stamps, noisy paint texture, added film grain, decorative particles, text or UI. Smooth clean areas are desirable. Do not change the composition, invent new props, turn the boat toward camera, or crop the mast.
